subject: geography

items.q: Where do most earthquakes and volcanoes occur?
items.correct: At plate boundaries, where tectonic plates meet and move.
items.random_wrong: Only where the weather is hot.
items.why: Plate boundaries concentrate the stresses that cause earthquakes and volcanic activity.

items.correct: Sudden movement at plate boundaries releasing built-up stress.
items.why: Tectonic plates lock, build stress, then slip — releasing energy as an earthquake.
